messages:
sam_support: heads up — ACME (customer account acme-inc) is hitting a sustained spike of 429s on the /v1/rerank endpoint. they say it started after a traffic ramp yesterday, ~50% of rerank calls failing with 429s. they repro with a simple curl.

mira_eng: thanks, sam. do we have sample headers and rate-limit response? ask them for the raw response body and any X-RateLimit headers.

acme_cust: here is a raw one from this morning. whole payload trimmed for privacy:

acme_cust: ```http
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
Content-Type: application/json
X-RateLimit-Limit: 120
X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0
X-RateLimit-Reset: 1679011200
Retry-After: 60
{
  "error": {"type":"rate_limit","message":"Rerank throughput quota exceeded for tenant"},
  "meta": {"endpoint":"/v1/rerank","tenant_id":"acme-inc"}
}
```

sam_support: they included a streaming batch size of ~64 per request and send bursts at 10 rps, mostly from a single API key.

jeff_sre: that X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0 + Retry-After 60 suggests token-level quota enforcement kicking in. rerank is expensive because we compute cross-scores — we have a separate quota bucket for rerank.

mira_eng: confirmed — rerank traffic is counted under the "rerank_units" quota which is more restrictive. Per-tenant default is 120 units/min. 64-item batch * 10 rps = 6400 items/min -> exceeds unit allotment quickly.

acme_cust: oh wow. the SDK doc mentioned "requests per minute" but not the per-item unit math. can we get an immediate workaround? customers are seeing production errors.

sam_support: short-term mitigation suggestions requested.

oncall_nina: @mira_eng and @jeff_sre we should propose a rate-limiting/backoff pattern and consider temporary quota bump while sales engages. Also check if tokenized billing impacted.

mira_eng: propose these immediate steps — 1) reduce batch_size to 8 or less for rerank during the ramp, 2) implement exponential backoff honoring Retry-After header, 3) use jittered leaky-bucket client-side rate limiter to spread bursts, 4) if accuracy allows, use sampling (pre-filter candidate set) to shrink rerank inputs.

jeff_sre: I'll run an infra-side check to ensure we didn't mis-classify their requests as scraping. also checking if quota controller had a regression (recent deploy that touched quota code).

billing_bot: flagged possibility: if they exceed free trial quota, billing must approve overage. created ticket BLG-4821.

sam_support: sent a short how-to to acme with code patch and curl examples:

sam_support: ```bash
# throttle client-side to 5 rps with batch size 8
for i in {1..1000}; do
  python -c "import requests, time
headers={'Authorization':'Bearer ${API_KEY}'}
payload={'queries': [...8 items...]}
resp=requests.post('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank', json=payload, headers=headers)
print(resp.status_code, resp.headers.get('Retry-After'))
if resp.status_code==429: time.sleep(int(resp.headers.get('Retry-After', 1)))
else: time.sleep(0.2)
"
done
```

acme_cust: testing reduced batch now, seems much better. dropped errors from 50% to ~2% in first 10 mins. thanks.

mira_eng: good. longer-term we should provide clearer docs and telemetry: 1) show per-API-key rerank_unit consumption in Console 2) suggest default client patterns in SDKs to avoid accidental bursts 3) surface the rerank quota in onboarding. filing internal ticket INF-1297 for Console telemetry.

jeff_sre: infra check done — no regressions on quota controller. the spike matched a legitimate traffic ramp from acme; quota enforcement behaved as designed. I increased the logging trace for their tenant to 10x for next 30m to help root-cause if something else shows up.

sam_support: acme requested temporary quota increase while they redo client. can sales/prod evaluate a temporary bumped quota or dedicated pool?

mira_eng: temporary bump acceptable for enterprise customers. needs Sales + Billing approval. recommended path: 1) Sales/AM confirm commitment 2) Issue a dedicated capacity trial or quota lift for 72h 3) schedule follow-up to migrate to batching/sampling or Dedicated product.

billing_bot: BLG-4821 updated: requested 72h trial quota increase for tenant acme-inc. Marked P2.

oncall_nina: flagging for oncall awareness in case rerank throttling causes cascading retries from the customer hitting other endpoints. watch for increased ingress or retry storms.

sam_support: closing loop with acme: we applied temporary advice (reduce batch, backoff). sales loop started. will monitor.

mira_eng: follow-ups: - docs patch to add "rerank units" explainer and examples - SDK change to default safe batch size for rerank - add per-key rerank unit metric to Console Insights (INF-1297)

jeff_sre: adding a synthetic test that simulates heavy rerank batching to ensure controller thresholds are tuned and latency SLOs hold. ticket SRE-801.

acme_cust: confirmed reduced errors and accepted 72h trial. thanks everyone for quick turnaround :thumbsup:
